title: The Sims Legacy Collection — black screen on launch (Apple Silicon)
body:
Reported by a user over Reddit DM (handle withheld).

## Report

> I am trying to get The Sims 1 available on Steam on my M4 MacBook, and the game installed just fine, but when it launches it opens to nothing but a black screen.

## Game

- **The Sims Legacy Collection** — Steam app id [3314060](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3314060/The_Sims_Legacy_Collection/)
- EA's 2025 re-release of the original 2000 game.
- No entry in the database yet (103 games, none for any Sims title).

## Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| Chip | M4 MacBook (exact model not given) |
| macOS | not reported |
| Highball version | not reported |
| Engine | not reported, presumably the default |
| Renderer | not reported, presumably the default (dxmt) |

## Status

Install completes; launch produces a black screen. Investigating.

The leading hypothesis is the game's graphics API era. Highball ships four backends — `wined3d`, `dxmt` (D3D10/11), `d3dmetal` (D3D11/12) and `dxvk` (D3D9/10/11). None of them implements **DirectDraw or Direct3D 7**, which is the era the original Sims comes from, so such a title falls through to Wine's builtin `ddraw` on top of wined3d/OpenGL. That is unverified: it depends on whether EA changed the renderer for the 2025 release, which is one of the things being checked.

Do not treat that as the answer until it is confirmed. Findings will be posted as a comment.

## Still needed from the reporter

- The launch log, and the macOS + Highball versions.
- Whether anything renders at all (window title bar, audio, EA splash) or the window is black from the first frame.
